maya: FYI all - midweek all-hands moved to Wed 11:00am PT due to timezone conflicts. Short 35m agenda. Please add Qs or post anonymously here: https://forms.gle/RW-AH-anon 

lee: Agenda draft below. Trying to keep updates tight.

sam: Quick ask - Ops will show the Dedicated SLA banners and the new Bronze/Silver/Gold doc. Ops, can you confirm theres no forced migration for existing customers?

viv: Policy will do a 3-min block about the audit export schema and retention policy change (90 -> 180). Will attach FAQ before the meeting.

lee: Agenda:
```
11:00-11:08 CEO update (Maya)
11:08-11:18 Ops demo: SLA tiers + burst policy (Sam)
11:18-11:24 Policy: audit export + retention (Viv)
11:24-11:30 Rapid Q&A
```

maya: Heads-up on slides: please keep customer screenshots redacted. If you're sharing partner-specific info, mark as "confidential" and DM me.

anon_q_bot: Submit anonymously: https://forms.gle/RW-AH-anon

allhands_bot: Reminder: recording will be posted and slides uploaded.

sam: Confirmed - no forced changes to current committed contracts. Upgrades are opt-in. We'll provide migration tooling for teams that want to switch SLA tiers.

viv: Also I'll show how audit-log exports now include route_id and model_variant fields. FAQ includes mapping to existing SIEM ingestion.

lee: Please RSVP to the calendar so we can estimate time for live Qs. If you have a specific block to surface in the roundtable, drop a 1-line ticket reference.

maya: Thanks all. We'll keep this bite-sized. See you Wed. :sparkles:
